scope: Plan only: preserve exact HEADs under explicit archive refs, then remove only these clean historical worktrees with ordinary git worktree remove; no force. No ref or worktree mutation has been performed.
size_limit: du allocated bytes are an inventory estimate, not a measured filesystem free-space gain.

process_reference_check.scope: Read-only /proc cwd symlinks, open-file symlinks, and mapped-file paths. Exact candidate path or descendants only.
limitations: A point-in-time scan cannot prevent a process from accessing a candidate later.
Permission-denied /proc entries cannot establish absence of references; privileged follow-up is needed before deletion.
Command-line path strings are not interpreted as ownership or activity.
process_reference_check.execution: unsandboxed host process inspection as eric; not sudo
